The results split into generic under-$1,000 affiliate rankings that ignore RV use (1, 2, 6, 8, 9), RV lists that ignore the budget (3, 5, 0 partially), an off-target battery page (4), a category explainer (10), and two untested RV listicles with sub-$1,000 picks (7, 11).
